about: E2 (F1): test-strategy decides each layer in its own `test_layers` row (keyed `code` and `layer`), and each step-plan criterion carries `confirm: executed|searched|inspected`, the names the built branch uses. Written against 9ed4ec24 (arm T, the text-only batch); prompt-only, so the rows are a table in the summary, not a gated field.

edits.old:
Name each code surface's native unit harness; an
   absent one is prerequisite work for prepare, never N/A.
edits.new:
Name each code surface's native unit harness; an
   absent one is prerequisite work for prepare, never N/A. Write a `test_layers` table there, one row per code
   surface and layer the request touches: `| code | layer | harness | status | reason |`, layer `unit`,
   `component` or `e2e`, status `available`, `prerequisite` (prepare builds it before the first item that needs it)
   or `unverified` (why no runner can exist there; never for unit or component). Decide each row alone: a missing
   tool for one layer decides only that row.

edits.old:
say whether it must be exercised or inspection suffices, and name the
   R-<n> served.
edits.new:
end it with `confirm: executed` (a command runs the behaviour; a text
   search runs nothing), `confirm: searched` (a command searches text the item writes) or `confirm: inspected`
   naming the `test_layers` row (code and layer) whose status is `unverified`, and name the R-<n> served.
